name: Blueprint Trigger
description:
Blueprint Trigger helps product and design teams capture incoming requests clearly before anyone opens Figma. It acts as a structured intake interviewer — asking the right questions, detecting ambiguous or mixed requests, and producing a ready-to-use Trigger card.

This is Step 1 of the Blueprint Hub methodology, designed for teams working under pressure, especially when the Design System is still being built. The skill adapts automatically to three roles: Designer, Product Manager, and Functional Analyst. Works in English and Spanish.
longDescription:
Ships **1 skill**, `blueprint-trigger` (Captures, clarifies, and documents incoming product requests before any design work begins — the Trigger step of the…).

Installs with `claude plugin install blueprint-trigger@claude-community` from `DanielaGallardoio/blueprint-trigger`.
